data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at the start of the year were GBP 30.259m. During 2018 there was adverse prior-year development of GBP 4.311m (a 14.3% deterioration relative to opening gross reserves), reported in the claims movements note as "Movement arising from prior years". The report attributes reserve strain to a series of catastrophe events affecting prior years (notably Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, earthquakes in Mexico and Californian wildfires) and large loss development across the portfolio, resulting in a net strengthening of prior-year reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: The YOA has been impacted by a series of catastrophe events - Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, the earthquakes in Mexico and wildfires in California.
The YOA has also been impacted by a series of catastrophe events - Hurricanes Florence and Michael, and Californian wildfires Camp and Woolsey.
The provision for outstanding claims is based on evaluations of reported claims and estimates for losses incurred but not reported ("IBNR").
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding and the prior-year movement are taken directly from Note 12 movements (gross column). The exact reserve movement is reported in the claims movements table as "Movement arising from prior years 4,311". No breakdown of the prior-year movement by line of business or monetary attribution to specific events is provided. A small claims development table is present but limited; no full multi-year triangle for all older years is available. Premium mix is taken from the managing agent's divisional summary (cal year column) because no separate regulatory segmental note was found; recorded as 'mix from divisional summary'.
